decided: A change's account of what it built is first written when apply is complete, and rewritten only while that stays true: a review walk of the finished change rewrites it when a fix changes what it says, and when a review reopens work, the account is rewritten once, when apply is complete again, so the program brief always describes finished work.
alternatives: rewrite the account in every apply session whose work changes what it says, whether or not apply is complete
why: The user chose it at the change's proposal walk: one rule covers the first account and every rewrite, and the brief never shows half-done work.

defines.definition: a change's plain-language record of what it built, each new place the user is asked something or where a setting now changes what happens, and where the work left its stage's charter
every task of the change is done, or each task left is a check handed to the user to make themselves
a session in which the AI works through the change's tasks
